context: Tests environment set-up, ID-versus-title handling, JSON export and rate-limit discipline for bulk citation requests.

checklist.name: Environment set up first
checklist.description: Creates a virtual environment and installs requirements.txt (following the setup reference) before the first run

checklist.name: Title not passed to paper subcommand
checklist.description: Does not use the title string as the --paper-id value

checklist.name: References fetched
checklist.description: Uses the citations subcommand with --type references for the reference list

checklist.name: JSON export used
checklist.description: Saves output using --format json and --output candidates.json

checklist.name: Search used when only a title is known
checklist.description: Says that a title-only lookup goes through the search subcommand, not paper

checklist.name: Bulk loop not run unthrottled
checklist.description: Does not issue 150 back-to-back citation requests in a tight loop

checklist.name: Rate limit stated
checklist.description: States the limit of 100 requests per 5 minutes without an API key

checklist.name: Mitigation offered
checklist.description: Proposes a sleep between requests, batching, or setting SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY

checklist.name: No automatic triage
checklist.description: Does not run triage-paper on any result without asking the user

checklist.name: Results not called complete
checklist.description: Does not claim the references or search output are exhaustive or the most important papers
